'''Starsnow''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. His [[Starsnow (Jedi)|son]] was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who perished during the [[Sacking of Coruscant|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], Starsnow served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] circa [[3643 BBY]] following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Part of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]-era Senate, Starsnow mourned the death of his son, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Starsnow (Jedi)|Starsnow]] and a victim of the [[Sacking of Coruscant|Sith attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the end of the war. The distraught senator would eventually hire a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] led by [[Memnon Demaratus]] to retrieve his son's lost journal from the ruins of the Temple.<ref name="TOR" />

The mercenaries would fail, due to the heavy Imperial presence at the Temple, and their leader [[Memnon Demaratus]] would inform a traveling hero about the job. The hero braved the Imperial forces in the Temple, recovering the journal from the Sith who had already acquired it. They returned the journal to the Senator, who thanked them for easing a father's pain.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Senator Starsnow was created for the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the mission "Insult to Injury".<ref name="TOR" />
